Fedorivka (Chubarivka) Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Almost nothing is known about a Jewish cemetery or community specifically in Fedorivka — renamed Chubarivka from 1960 to 2016 — though nearby, the Jews of the Krasnoselka colony were protected by Fedorivka's peasants during the pogroms of 1882, a rare instance in this collection of documented local protection rather than violence. In the 2010s, a homeowner discovered a single Jewish gravestone, dated 1902, while ploughing her garden with a tractor — a complete surprise, since no one in the village had ever heard of a Jewish cemetery there. The stone is now preserved at the museum in Polohy.
